canonicalization.json: RFC8259 object keys sorted, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false, no final newline
canonicalization.set_arrays: sort by stable ID and reject duplicates
canonicalization.ordered_arrays: preserve only when order_semantics is declared
canonicalization.digest: SHA-256 lowercase hexadecimal of the canonical JSON object named by digest_manifests

members: fields whose field_id occurs in those records.field_ids

guards: AwaitingArchitect requires all packets Complete and current head snapshot
AwaitingOwner requires same-subject/head Project Architect ReservedChoice
Complete requires packets Complete, unchanged candidate/current head, matching Run acceptance, authoritative merges and post-merge gates
AwaitingOwner requires same-subject/head Project Architect ReservedChoice
Running requires current active lease, packet Leased or Running, and committed matching context
non-success requires reason and evidence with no result commit

quality_contracts.protected_outcome: Schema-5 cannot lose accepted data or permit contradictory correction carriers.
quality_contracts.operating_model: Trusted Linux service, real schema-4 SQLite, DDL failure, concurrent open, reopen, invalid FK/enum/conditional values.
quality_contracts.explicit_exclusions: Disk failure, hostile database editing, downgrade, backup, distributed writers.
quality_contracts.assurance_level: Transactional additive local migration and closed deterministic carrier validation.
quality_contracts.implementation_boundary: sqlite3, storage.py, operational_state.py, named tests; no dependency or ORM.
quality_contracts.proportionality_ceiling: Three tables, necessary guards, and one event-type trigger replacement only.
quality_contracts.stop_rule: Any schema-4 rewrite, unexpressible field relation, or second source of field truth returns to Project Architect.

quality_contracts.protected_outcome: A stale or unauthorized lifecycle command cannot skip a gate or leave state detached from its event.
quality_contracts.operating_model: Finite matrices, optimistic versions, exact replay, invalid guards, notification/acceptance/merge authority and context gate.
quality_contracts.explicit_exclusions: Scheduler, Git/GitHub queries, delivery, merge execution, distributed coordination.
quality_contracts.assurance_level: One transaction and exactly one composite event for every declared command.
quality_contracts.proportionality_ceiling: Only declared matrices, guards, APIs, events and accepted schema.
quality_contracts.stop_rule: A new state, authority policy, event multiplicity, or outside path returns to Project Architect.

quality_contracts.protected_outcome: Contention, interruption, expiry or restart cannot create duplicate ownership or external action.
quality_contracts.operating_model: One service, SQLite contention, seams, active/expired/orphan/conflict leases, repeat startup and stale observations.
quality_contracts.explicit_exclusions: Machine reboot proof, worker execution, Git/network reconciliation, corrupt database and multi-host writers.
quality_contracts.assurance_level: Deterministic local atomic claim and conservative restart reconciliation.
quality_contracts.implementation_boundary: operational_state.py, recovery.py, sqlite3 and named tests.
quality_contracts.proportionality_ceiling: Finite recovery outcomes and no redispatch or external call.
quality_contracts.stop_rule: Any case not reducible to observe/block/return or any need for distributed coordination returns to Project Architect.

quality_contracts.protected_outcome: Completion, first correction, return, resolution and learning facts cannot be lost, fabricated or split across contradictory events.
quality_contracts.operating_model: Both gate arrival orders, four outcomes, restart, duplicate/stale evidence, return/resolution and known/unavailable timing.
quality_contracts.explicit_exclusions: Reviewer judgment, final correction authorization, routing changes inferred from metrics, Atlas and external analytics.
quality_contracts.assurance_level: Closed append-only evidence with deterministic aggregation and one composite event per command.
quality_contracts.implementation_boundary: operational_state.py, accepted evidence table and named tests.
quality_contracts.proportionality_ceiling: One initial gate pair, one StandardCorrection, one return/resolution and packet-level learning.
quality_contracts.stop_rule: Missing immutable evidence, a new failure class, or a carrier not expressible by canonical fields returns to Project Architect.

quality_contracts.protected_outcome: A second correction cannot be granted optimistically, exceed M0-D17, or duplicate attempt/lease/locks.
quality_contracts.operating_model: Every M0-D17 eligibility pass/fail, two targeted terminal gates, PA authority, concurrent/replayed resume, final outcome and third-correction attempt.
quality_contracts.explicit_exclusions: General review restart, changed architecture/schema/API/product behavior, Owner-reserved choices, third correction.
quality_contracts.assurance_level: Immutable eligibility and exactly-once local resume within the accepted single-service model.
quality_contracts.implementation_boundary: operational_state.py and named final/cumulative tests; no C, M1-03 or external action.
quality_contracts.proportionality_ceiling: At most one normal and one PA-authorized final correction.
quality_contracts.stop_rule: Any failed eligibility, changed boundary, missing gate evidence, failed final correction or third attempt freezes and returns to Project Architect.

requirements.claim: Exact accepted base and canonical planning contract are frozen before implementation.
Schema 4 migrates additively to schema 5 with every accepted object preserved except the closed event trigger.
All table columns and carrier rules derive from the canonical field and relation records.
Every finite lifecycle edge and guard accepts or rejects exactly as declared with replay-before-stale semantics.
Notification, acceptance, merge and Run completion preserve their authority and exact-head boundaries.
All B2 APIs preserve M0-D11 containment and every mutation emits exactly its one declared composite event.
Claim, heartbeat and release are atomic, idempotent and contention-safe.
Startup recovery produces only the finite observe, expire/block/wait, conflict/return and stale-observation outcomes.
All B3 routes preserve containment, rollback completely at every seam and emit one ordered composite event per command.
Completion manifests and gate coverage are closed, deterministic and two-way complete.
Both initial terminal gates are unioned once before StandardCorrection number 1 is authorized.
Return and resolution atomically preserve evidence, packet/wait state and exact next authority/action in one event each.
PacketLearning preserves timing, correction, finding, late-requirement and reusable-change facts without inferred values or policy.
Only matching terminal targeted gates and every true M0-D17 fact permit PA authorization of correction number 2.
The authorized final correction resumes packet, attempt, lease and locks atomically and idempotently.
Final attempt completion returns to Integration and no third, new-class, scope-changing or unapproved correction can mutate state.
The exact final B head passes all B1-B5 proofs, regressions, stress, clean handoff, full review coverage and PA acceptance.
